name: dub
label: Dub
description: Dub is the modern link attribution platform for creating, managing, and analysing short links, tracking conversions, and running affiliate programmes.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To obtain your Dub API key:
1. Go to [https://app.dub.co/settings/tokens](https://app.dub.co/settings/tokens)
2. Click **Create API Key**
3. Give your key a name and select the required scopes
4. Copy the key — it starts with `dub_` (e.g. `dub_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`)
5. Paste it here

> **Required scopes:** `links.read`, `links.write`, `webhooks.write` (for triggers)

create_link.label: Create Link
create_link.description: Create a new shortened link in your Dub workspace.

url.label: Destination URL
url.description: The full destination URL the short link should redirect to.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: The domain to use for the short link (e.g. `dub.sh`). If omitted, the primary workspace domain is used.

key.label: Short Link Slug
key.description: Custom slug for the short link (e.g. `my-promo`). If omitted, a random 7-character slug is generated.

externalId.label: External ID
externalId.description: Your internal database ID for this link. Must be unique per workspace. Useful for looking up the link later.

title.label: Title
title.description: A human-readable title for the link (used in the Dub dashboard).

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of what the link points to.

image.label: OG Image URL
image.description: Custom link preview image (og:image). Used when Custom Link Previews (`proxy`) is enabled.

video.label: OG Video URL
video.description: Custom link preview video (og:video). Used when Custom Link Previews (`proxy`) is enabled.

tags.label: Tag Names
tags.description: List of tag names to attach to this link.

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: The unique ID of an existing folder to assign this link to.

expiresAt.label: Expires At
expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the link should expire (e.g. `2025-12-31T23:59:59Z`). Expired links redirect to the expiration URL.

expiredUrl.label: Expired URL
expiredUrl.description: URL to redirect to after the link expires.

password.label: Password
password.description: Password-protect the link. Visitors must enter this password before being redirected.

trackConversion.label: Track Conversions
trackConversion.description: Whether to track conversions for this link.

proxy.label: Custom Link Previews
proxy.description: Enable Custom Link Previews (og:title, og:description, og:image) for this link.

rewrite.label: Cloaked URL (URL Rewriting)
rewrite.description: Cloak the destination URL — visitors see the short link URL in the browser.

doIndex.label: Allow Search Engine Indexing
doIndex.description: Allow search engines to index this short link.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Archive this link immediately after creation.

ios.label: iOS Redirect URL
ios.description: Redirect iOS device visitors to this URL instead.

android.label: Android Redirect URL
android.description: Redirect Android device visitors to this URL instead.

comments.label: Comments
comments.description: Internal notes about this link (not shown to visitors).

utm_term.label: UTM Term
utm_term.description: UTM term parameter for paid search keywords.

utm_content.label: UTM Content
utm_content.description: UTM content parameter for A/B testing.

list_links.label: List Links
list_links.description: Retrieve a paginated list of links in your Dub workspace.

domain.label: Domain Filter
domain.description: Filter by a specific domain (e.g. `dub.sh`). Leave empty to return all domains.

tagNames.label: Tag Name Filter
tagNames.description: Filter by one or more tag names.

search.label: Search Query
search.description: Search links by their URL, title, or slug.

userId.label: User ID Filter
userId.description: Filter links created by a specific user ID.

showArchived.label: Include Archived Links
showArchived.description: Whether to include archived links in the results.

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Number of links to return per page (1–100). Default is 100.

update_link.label: Update Link
update_link.description: Update an existing Dub link. Only the fields you fill in will be updated.

linkId.label: Link ID
linkId.description: The ID of the link to update (e.g. `clv3g2...`). Find this from the Create Link or List Links actions.

url.label: New Destination URL
url.description: Update the destination URL the link redirects to.

key.label: New Slug
key.description: Update the short link slug (the part after the domain).

image.label: OG Image URL
image.description: Update the custom link preview image (og:image).

video.label: OG Video URL
video.description: Update the custom link preview video (og:video).

tags.label: Tag Names
tags.description: Replace the link's tags with this new list of tag names. Send an empty array to clear all tags.

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: Move this link to a different folder by its ID.

expiresAt.label: Expires At
expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the link should expire. Set to empty to remove expiration.

expiredUrl.label: Expired URL
expiredUrl.description: URL to redirect to after expiration.

password.label: Password
password.description: Update the password for this link. Leave blank to remove password protection.

trackConversion.label: Track Conversions
trackConversion.description: Whether to track conversions for this link.

proxy.label: Custom Link Previews
proxy.description: Enable or disable Custom Link Previews (og:title, og:description, og:image) for this link.

doIndex.label: Allow Search Engine Indexing
doIndex.description: Allow search engines to index this short link.

comments.label: Comments
comments.description: Update internal notes for this link.

delete_link.label: Delete Link
delete_link.description: Permanently delete a Dub link. This action cannot be undone.

linkId.label: Link ID
linkId.description: The ID of the link to delete (e.g. `clv3g2...`). Find this from the Create Link or List Links actions.
